details: Malicious package. `baileyscrew` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Socket/Denzy-ZeroDay.js`, loaded by `lib/Socket/messages-send.js`, stamps event messages sent through the library with forwarded-newsletter context naming the hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channel 120363428062966280@newsletter ("Denzy ZeroDay"), so recipients see the victim's message as forwarded from that channel. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID. Versions 1.4.1 through 1.4.3 carry this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
